zh: 同步性；同时发生
en: the fact of two or more things happening at exactly the same time

zh: （使）同步，在时间上一致，同速进行
使同步，使一致（使数据在不同的计算机或移动电子设备上同步更新）
en: the fact of happening at the same time or moving at the same speed as something else; the act of making something do this
ex: synchronization of the business cycle throughout the EU
整个欧盟的商业周期同步

zh: （使）同步，在时间上一致，同速进行
使同步，使一致（使数据在不同的计算机或移动电子设备上同步更新）
en: to happen at the same time or to move at the same speed as something; to make something do this
ex: The sound track did not synchronize with the action.
声迹与动作不同步。

zh: 花样游泳（组员伴着音乐同步进行）
en: a sport in which groups of swimmers move in patterns in the water to music

zh: 同时发生（或存在）的；同步的；共时的
en: happening or existing at the same time

zh: 向斜
en: an area of ground where layers of rock in the earth’s surface have been folded into a curve that is lower in the middle than at the ends

zh: 切分的，切分音乐的（节拍强弱倒置）
en: in syncopated rhythm the strong beats are made weak and the weak beats are made strong

zh: a change to the rhythm of a piece of music, so that the strong beats become weak and the weak beats become strong
en: a change to the rhythm of a piece of music, so that the strong beats become weak and the weak beats become strong
ex: a few jazzy syncopations
几首爵士乐

zh: 词中语音省略（如将 library 发成 /ˈlaɪbri/）
en: the dropping of a sound or sounds in the middle of a word when it is spoken, for example the pronunciation of library as /laɪbri/

zh: （不同宗教、哲学或思想的）融合
（语言发展过程中词的）屈折形式融合，辑合
en: the mixing of different religions, philosophies or ideas

zh: 工团主义，工联主义（认为企业应由全体员工共同拥有及管理）
en: the belief that factories, businesses, etc. should be owned and managed by all the people who work in them

zh: 工团主义者；工联主义者
en: a person who believes in syndicalism

zh: 辛迪加；企业联合组织；财团；私人联合会
en: a group of people or companies who work together and help each other in order to achieve a particular aim
ex: a crime syndicate
犯罪集团

zh: 把（文章、图片、电视节目等）出售给多个媒体
en: the act of selling an article, a photograph, a television programme, etc. to several different newspapers, etc.
ex: The Oprah Winfrey Show entered national syndication in 1986.
奥普拉·温弗瑞（Oprah Winfrey）秀于1986年进入全国联合组织。

zh: 综合征；综合症状
典型意见；典型表现
en: a set of physical conditions that show you have a particular disease or medical problem
ex: PMS or premenstrual syndrome
经前综合征

zh: 举偶法，提喻法（用局部代表整体或用整体代表局部的修辞手法）
en: a word or phrase in which a part of something is used to represent a whole, or a whole is used to represent a part of something. For example, in ‘Australia lost by two goals’, Australia is used to represent the Australian team.

zh: 协同作用，协同增效作用（多方共同协作所产生的效果优于各自单独行动的效果）
en: connected with the extra energy, power, success, etc. that is achieved by two or more people, companies or elements working together, instead of on their own
ex: a synergistic relationship between work roles and home roles
工作角色和家庭角色之间的协同关系

zh: 协同作用，协同增效作用（多方共同协作所产生的效果优于各自单独行动的效果）
en: in way that makes use of the extra energy, power, success, etc. that is achieved by two or more people, companies or elements working together, instead of on their own
ex: Fortunately, exercise and diet work synergistically.
幸运的是，运动和饮食可以协同工作。

zh: 协同作用，协同增效作用（多方共同协作所产生的效果优于各自单独行动的效果）
en: the extra energy, power, success, etc. that is achieved by two or more people, companies or elements working together, instead of on their own
ex: Managing effective teams is a matter of achieving synergy between the individual members.
管理有效的团队是在单个成员之间实现协同作用的问题。

zh: 教会会议
en: an official meeting of Church members to discuss religious matters and make important decisions
ex: the General Synod of the Church of England
英格兰教会总会议

zh: 同义词
en: a word or expression that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another in the same language
ex: ‘Big’ and ‘large’ are synonyms.
big 和 large 是同义词。

zh: 同义的
等同于…的
en: having the same, or nearly the same, meaning
ex: Few words are truly synonymous.
很少有真正的同义词。

zh: 同义的
en: in a way that uses or has the same meaning, or nearly the same meaning
ex: The terms ‘form’ and ‘shape’ are often used synonymously.
术语“形式”和“形状”通常是同义词。

zh: 同义；同义关系
en: the fact of two or more words or expressions having the same meaning

zh: （著作、剧本等的）大纲，提要，概要，梗概
en: a summary of a piece of writing, a play, etc.
ex: The programme gives a brief synopsis of the plot.
该程序提供了该情节的简要提要。

zh: in a form of a summary or synopsis; taking or involving a comprehensive mental view
en: in a form of a summary or synopsis; taking or involving a comprehensive mental view
ex: a broad synoptic view of history
广泛的历史概要

zh: （含）滑膜的
en: having a membrane (= a piece of very thin skin) containing liquid between the bones, which allows the joint to move freely

zh: 句法的
en: connected with syntax
ex: syntactic rules/structures
句法规则/结构

zh: 句法的
en: in a way that is connected with syntax
ex: to be syntactically correct
在句法上正确

zh: （语言）语段，结构段，结构体
en: a unit of language consisting of sets of phonemes, words, or phrases that are arranged in order

zh: connected with the way in which two or more units of language are arranged in order to make a correct clause or sentence
en: connected with the way in which two or more units of language are arranged in order to make a correct clause or sentence

zh: 句法；句法规则
语法；句法；语构
en: the way that words and phrases are put together to form sentences in a language; the rules of grammar for this
ex: The instructions were not carried out because of a syntax error.
由于语法错误，未执行指令。

zh: 音响合成器
en: a synthesizer (= an electronic machine for producing different sounds. Synthesizers are used as musical instruments, especially for copying the sounds of other instruments, and for copying speech sounds.)

zh: a type of pop music that uses synthesizers and other electronic instruments
en: a type of pop music that uses synthesizers and other electronic instruments
ex: One of Norway's biggest synth-pop bands is making a comeback.
挪威最大的合成流行乐团之一即将卷土重来。

zh: 综合；结合；综合体
（物质在动植物体内的）合成
（人工的）合成
（用电子手段对声音、音乐或语音的）合成
en: the act of combining separate ideas, beliefs, styles, etc.; a mixture or combination of ideas, beliefs, styles, etc.
ex: the synthesis of art with everyday life
艺术与日常生活的结合

zh: （通过化学手段或生物过程）合成
（音响）合成
综合
en: to produce a substance by means of chemical or biological processes
ex: Students learn to synthesize information and search for what is relevant.
学生学习综合信息并搜索相关信息。

zh: 音响合成器
en: an electronic machine for producing different sounds. Synthesizers are used as musical instruments, especially for copying the sounds of other instruments, and for copying speech sounds.
ex: a speech synthesizer
语音合成器

zh: 人造的；（人工）合成的
综合（型）的
en: artificial; made by combining chemical substances rather than being produced naturally by plants or animals
ex: synthetic drugs/fabrics
合成药物／织物

zh: 人造的；（人工）合成的
en: artificially; in a way that combines chemical substances rather than using natural products from plants or animals
ex: synthetically produced drugs
人工合成药物

zh: 梅毒
en: a disease that gets worse over a period of time, spreading from the sexual organs to the skin, bones, muscles and brain. It is caught by having sex with a person who already has the disease.

zh: suffering from syphilis; connected with syphilis
en: suffering from syphilis; connected with syphilis

zh: a tube that is used to move liquid from one container down into another, lower container
en: a tube that is used to move liquid from one container down into another, lower container

zh: 锡拉丘兹（美国纽约州城市，位于安大略湖东南）
en: a city in the US state of New York, south-east of Lake Ontario

zh: 叙利亚人；叙利亚的；叙利亚人的
en: (a person) from Syria

zh: （皮下）注射器
吸管；唧筒
en: a plastic or glass tube with a long hollow needle that is used for putting drugs, etc. into a person’s body or for taking a small amount of blood from a person
ex: a beach scattered with used syringes
丢满了废弃注射器的沙滩

zh: 糖水（罐头水果常用）
糖浆
en: a sweet liquid made from sugar and water, often used in cans of fruit
ex: pears in syrup
糖水梨

zh: 糖浆般黏稠的；含糖浆的
缠绵的；过分多情的
en: thick and sticky like syrup; containing syrup
ex: Heat the liquid until it is thick and syrupy.
加热液体，直到其变稠粘稠为止。

zh: （思想或理论）体系；方法；制度；体制
系统
身体；（器官）系统
（尤指不公正的统治或管理）制度，体系，集团
en: an organized set of ideas or theories or a particular way of doing something
ex: reform of the country's education system
国家教育体制改革

zh: 计算机系统管理员；系统操作员；电子公告板管理员
en: a person who manages a computer system or electronic communication service

zh: 系统单元，系统部件（包含中央处理器，不含键盘、鼠标和显示器的电脑主体部分）
en: the main part of a computer, separate from the keyboard, mouse and monitor, that contains the unit that controls all the other parts of the system

zh: 成体系的；系统的；有条理的；有计划有步骤的
en: done according to a system or plan, in a complete, efficient or determined way
ex: a systematic approach to solving the problem
系统地解决问题的办法

zh: in a complete, efficient or determined way that follows a system or plan
en: in a complete, efficient or determined way that follows a system or plan
ex: The search was carried out systematically.
搜查已按照部署执行。

zh: 使系统化；使成体系；使条理化
en: the act of arranging something according to a system

zh: 使系统化；使成体系；使条理化
en: to arrange something according to a system

zh: 涉及全系统的；系统的；影响全身的；全身的
（农药等）内吸的
en: affecting or connected with the whole of something, especially the human body
ex: a systemic disease
一种全身性疾病

zh: 涉及全系统的；系统的；影响全身的；全身的
en: in a way that affects the whole of something, especially the human body
ex: substances that are absorbed systemically
被系统吸收的物质

zh: 系统分析员
en: the job of analysing the needs of a business company or an organization and then designing processes for working efficiently using computer programs

zh: 系统分析员
en: a person whose job is to analyse the needs of a business company or an organization and then design processes for working efficiently using computer programs

zh: 心缩期
en: the stage of the heart’s rhythm when the heart pumps blood

zh: 心缩期
en: connected with the stage of the heart's rhythm when the heart pumps blood

zh: 圣多美和普林西比（由几内亚湾中两个主岛和几个小岛组成的国家）
en: a country consisting of two main islands and several smaller ones in the Gulf of Guinea

s'mores和其他篝火晚会
